Container.Name: domus
Container.Overview: 3D site models built from LINZ LiDAR, for comparing retaining wall options in the browser. Asks for an address when the Site folder is empty, then builds the model from public data. There is no login in the app: keep it off the internet, or put a login proxy in front. See docs/self-hosting.md.

Config.Name: Site
Config.Description: The site project: data, options, the built model and saved sketches. Sketches are SQLite, so use a direct pool path rather than /mnt/user. Owned by nobody:users.

Config.Name: LINZ API key
Config.Description: Free key from data.linz.govt.nz, for real boundaries and buildings. Without it, addresses go to OpenStreetMap and the lot is a stand-in square.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Comma-separated names to answer to besides IP addresses and localhost, such as your login proxy's.

Config.Name: Trust login proxy
Config.Description: 1 to take the user's name from a login proxy's X-Forwarded-User header, for labelling sketches. Leave 0 without a proxy.
